mentions.name: We Wade Awake
mentions.description: Live visual performance built with another artist, delivering a 25-minute immersive experience of a fever dream trip through a surreal Bayou. The latest iteration features fully dynamic and procedural world generation using Unreal PCG, with all input driven by two MIDI controllers, pushing Nanite and Lumen to their limits. It has been iterated on across four live performances.
mentions.source_excerpt: Me and another artist are having our fourth live performance of “We Wade Awake” [0] We’ve iterating on it each time, and the latest had a fully dynamic and procedural world generation using Unreal PCG. All input comes from two midi controllers, and we’ve built out a 25 minute experience of a fever dream trip through a surreal Bayou.
